text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both treading water with minimal daily moves, suggesting consolidation rather than conviction in either direction. The Fear & Greed index sits firmly in greed territory at 73, indicating retail confidence, though Bitcoin's dominant 59.2% share and $93B daily volume show healthy liquidity without extreme concentration. Solana's modest outperformance hints at some rotation into alternative L1s, but the overall picture is one of steadiness—risk appetite is present but not aggressive.
